items.claim: unscoped grid reads tagged lengths with the unit's affine offset
`bounds` makes the layer draw every line across the bounds, not just what is visible
grid lines and region clips are absolute float32 world coordinates, so they drift far from zero
`useGridCellHover` keeps a stale cell when the view, spacing or regions change without a pointer move
`sceneGridRegions` builds its child lists in quadratic time
items.note: There is no failing test for this one: it is a cost fix and timing would be the only way to show it. The existing `sceneGridRegions` tests pass.

items.claim: a NaN or infinite `offset` passes validation and `cellOf` returns a cell of NaNs
`useGridCellHover` binds `ref.current` once, so an element attached later or swapped by a remount gets no listeners (B, and the second half of A's hover finding)
items.note: This is the same commit as the stale-cell fix, with its own changeset. The listeners now follow `ref.current` after each render of the hook's component. An element that mounts without that component re-rendering still can't be seen through a `RefObject`, and the hook's doc now says so.
